The '''Grand Imperial''' was a casino and hotel on [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]]. [[Tirgee Benyalle]] owned it, and used it to host the meeting between [[Utoxx Prentioch]], [[Uther Kermen]], [[Talon Karrde]], and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] representatives to discuss export rights for Kaal's aquaculture industry. [[Boleb Hiiz]] managed the Grand Imperial for Benyalle.
